title: Varna Jalam
desc: A young man moves in with a retired police officer's family, but devises an evil plan to wreck the latter's family.

title: Avatharam
desc: Kuppaswamy, an innocent theatre enthusiast, falls in love with visually challenged Ponnama after joining a troupe. When the troupe struggles financially, the couple moves to the city.
Ram and Janani are high school sweethearts who eventually get married. However, when Ram suddenly commits suicide, a heartbroken and confused Janani tries to solve the enigma of his decision.

title: Vanavil
desc: Surya, Prakash and Priya are three IAS aspirants. When Surya and Priya fall in love, Prakash, Priya's secret admirer, silently becomes an enemy posing as a friend and plots to get rid of Surya.

title: Vivegam
desc: Ajay Kumar, a former counter-terrorism agent, is called for a special mission. However, he is betrayed by his friends and is accused of extremely treasonous acts.
